clauses.requirement: Side marker lamps (SM1, SM2): the colour of the light emitted shall be amber; however, it may be red if the rearmost side marker lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp or the stop lamp, or is grouped with, or has part of its light emitting surface in common with, the rear retro-reflector.
Reversing lamps (category AR) shall comply with the specific technical requirements of paragraph 5.8 of UN R148.

The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements of Table 10; where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively as a pair, photometric intensity may be verified only up to 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied; this condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and related documents (paragraph 3.1), and when approval is granted on this basis, paragraph 9.1.3 of the communication form (Annex 1) shall state that the device shall only be installed in a pair.

Reversing lamp category AR shall meet the luminous intensities of Table 10: minimum luminous intensity 8.0∙10^1 cd (par. 4.8.3.1 (a)); maximum luminous intensity 3.00∙10^2 cd (par. 4.8.3.1 (b)) in or above the h-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd below the h-plane down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D; standard light distribution per Figure A3-V (par. 4.8.3.1 (c)); angles of geometric visibility (par. 4.8.3.1 (d)) not applicable (N.A.).
Reversing lamps: there are no requirements for minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility.
Reversing lamps: there are no requirements for minimum or maximum area of the apparent surface.
Reversing lamps: there are no additional measurement requirements.
Reversing lamps: there are no additional specific requirements.
